examples.problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=-8x(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=-8y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Sketch the phase portrait of the linear system above.
examples.worked_solution:
Writing our system in matrix form, we have
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/01d652156896744699e5533725f537e9f203031fab369accc10c912839ebad11.png)
where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/2dff913b6a0163c9dff6e28d81690472f043de69e4796dffb58b16b933165450.png)

Since our system is decoupled, its eigenvalues are $\lambda_1=\lambda_2=-8$ with the corresponding eigenvectors $[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/c3fe70f694806cdfa2bb64064e3e97e8142c05c249def67cd22e5c21244a233b.png)

The general solution of the system is
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/3fd44b389c505756db88609e4ed7b78cdc6a2edeeb087edf3ed20034a9c909cf.png)

Notice that for each vector ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/fe0e0ebbdd9f7cd29ca5d2ca7633f829e682057024ba6c783fe7e10106a0bbfd.png) we get the straight-line solutions of the form
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/0a6ee4e5731289a20e011783360e0b17aa8e425995e13ee34950efd31cf73922.png)
that represent the line passing through the origin and parallel to the vector ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/a30588ff9f9c3f7db4b7840afddf97a38df27ef7cdef48f4a3037e76836cb6a1.png)

Since $e^{-8t} \to 0$ as $t \to \infty,$ these solutions approach the origin as $t \to \infty,$ so the origin is a stable node.

The phase portrait satisfying these conditions is the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/4c337f7f6b80f340859844e8217525db98230660d22e760c70218f0c282d21e9.png)
